personality_one_liner: A premium, smooth, and minimalist coffee shop POS blending Material You's expressive warmth with fist-friendly utility for high-speed transactions.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 44pt). Use md (12pt) for internal card padding, lg (16pt) for screen margins. Tonal spacing > hard borders.

do's: Use tonal layering and soft shadows instead of blur, matching the Material You aesthetic requested.
dont's: Do not use blur layers, rely on surfaceSecondary/surfaceTertiary and elevation.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry point for Admin/Kasir with an elegant coffee shop vibe.

states.error: Standard Material Snackbar for invalid credentials.

screens.layout: Fullscreen background image (blurred interior) layered with a gradient scrim (top to bottom). A bottom-aligned auth card (surfaceSecondary) containing large, fist-friendly inputs for PIN/Password and a prominent brandPrimary login CTA with android_ripple.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of KPIs, sales charts, and top products for Admin.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for KPI cards and chart area.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty store with 'Belum ada transaksi hari ini'.
states.error: Error state inside the chart card with a 'Coba Lagi' button.

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top section with a horizontal scroll of KPI summary cards (surfaceSecondary, soft shadow). Middle section holds the main Sales Chart (react-native-chart-kit). Bottom section lists Top Products using standard list items with leading product avatars.

screens.name: Cashier (POS)
screens.purpose: High-speed checkout screen for adding items, selecting toppings, and processing payments.

states.empty: Empty cart uses an icon and 'Keranjang kosong' text inside the bottom sheet.
states.error: Toast/Snackbar for failed actions (e.g., failed to add to cart).

screens.layout: Phone-first utility layout. Top: Sticky horizontal category chips (Minuman/Camilan/Mie/Topping) wrapping multiple rows. Middle: 2-column grid of product cards. Each card has a large image, bold title, and price. Tapping a product with toppings triggers a fast Bottom Sheet for customization. Bottom: A sticky CTA bar ('X Items • Rp Total') that, when swiped up or tapped, expands via @gorhom/bottom-sheet to reveal the full Cart, Discount input, and Payment Method selectors (Tunai/QRIS/Transfer/E-Wallet). The 'Bayar' button is massive and sticky at the bottom of the sheet.

screens.name: Product Master
screens.purpose: Manage catalog (Minuman, Camilan, Mie, Topping) and track stock.

states.empty: Illustration with 'Belum ada produk' and an 'Tambah Produk' CTA.

screens.layout: List view. Each row shows product thumbnail, title, category tag, price, and stock indicator (warning color if low stock). A persistent Floating Action Button (FAB) in brandPrimary at the bottom right for adding new products.

screens.name: Reports
screens.purpose: View and export daily/weekly/monthly sales data.

states.empty: Illustration of empty files with 'Data laporan kosong'.

screens.layout: Top section: Date range selectors. Middle: Summary totals. Bottom: List of transactions. Floating sticky CTA 'Ekspor PDF/Excel' at the bottom.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure store identity, theme, printer, and tax.
screens.layout: Standard Material settings list. Grouped by sections: Store Info, POS (Tax/Printer), Theme (Light/Dark mode toggle using Segmented Buttons). Printer config includes a Bluetooth discovery modal.

login_background.alt: Minimalist coffee shop interior blurred background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the exact color palette requested: Primary #2E7D32, Secondary #4E342E, Accent #D4A017, and Background #F7F7F7. Do not introduce any blue or purple tokens.
Implement 'Ripple Effect' heavily on Android using standard Pressable android_ripple prop for all buttons and list items.
Implement 'Hero Animation' using react-native-reanimated for transitioning from a product card on the Cashier screen to the topping customization modal/sheet.

Cashier screen MUST be thumb-friendly: The bottom cart summary should be a sticky bar that can be pulled up (using @gorhom/bottom-sheet) into a full checkout view, avoiding navigation away from the catalog.
Use Material Design 3 guidelines: elevated cards (shadow_tier: 2), large rounded corners (radius_tokens: lg), and distinct surface color layers.
Include an interactive Bluetooth modal placeholder within Settings for thermal printing.
Images MUST use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs via expo-image. Apply the mandatory top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) over the login background image.
Ensure Dark Mode dynamically maps colors without breaking contrast limits.
